title: 敞開式硬岩掘進機支撐~Support installation behind open hard-rock TBMs
focus: 敞開硬岩掘進後方的暴露跨度、岩塊支護與證據閉合~Exposure, block support and evidence closure behind open hard-rock TBMs
summary: 敞開式硬岩掘進機依靠撐靴傳遞反力，刀盤後方的岩面可被觀測，但暴露並不等於穩定。本課將岩塊幾何、未支護距離、噴層與錨栓的作用分開建模，再連接收斂、超挖、出碴與資料交接。課程中的梁、重量及時間公式是明示邊界的教學模型，不能據此決定現場進入條件或支護間距。~An open hard-rock TBM reacts through grippers and leaves rock behind the cutterhead available for observation, but exposure is not evidence of stability. This course separates block geometry, unsupported distance, sprayed lining and bolt action, then connects convergence, overbreak, muck handling and handover. Beam, weight and time relations have explicit teaching boundaries; they cannot determine field access conditions or support spacing.
history: 國際隧協以切削與重新撐緊兩階段解釋撐靴掘進，公開設備介紹則呈現硬岩機型與支護工作的介面。二〇〇九年公路隧道手冊提供系統性土建背景；二〇一四年的Stepney Green案例提醒學員，軟土分部襯砌的力流不能直接套在硬岩裸露頂拱。聖哥達基線隧道二〇一六年營運提供長隧道環境對照，本課不把其實際設備配置推廣為所有敞開機的共同細節。~ITA explains gripper advance through cutting and regripping phases, while public equipment descriptions identify hard-rock machines and their support interfaces. The 2009 road-tunnel manual supplies broader civil context. Stepney Green’s 2014 case is a contrast: soft-ground sequential lining behavior cannot simply be transferred to an exposed rock crown. Gotthard entering operation in 2016 supplies a long-tunnel setting, without turning that project’s equipment arrangements into universal details for every open machine.

units.title: 頂拱岩塊與自重路徑~Crown blocks and self-weight path
units.anchor: 頂拱岩塊與自重路徑~Crown blocks and self-weight path
units.mechanism: 岩體節理可能切出可移動塊體，其重力由剩餘岩橋、節理摩擦或已核准支護傳遞。僅從岩塊體積可估重量，卻不能證明運動方向與抗力；幾何辨識必須先於支護力的列帳。 假設塊體體積V=2.4 m³、岩石單位重γ=26 kN/m³，重量W=γV=62.4 kN；這不是單一錨栓的需求，也未檢核滑動面。 背部節理漏判會低估可移動體積，頂拱外觀完整仍可能有脫離面；若只用正面照片計重，支護討論會建立在錯誤幾何上並低估掉塊後果。~Discontinuities can isolate movable blocks whose weight is carried by rock bridges, joint resistance or approved support. Volume estimates weight, but neither movement direction nor resistance. Geometric interpretation must therefore precede any accounting of support force. Assume block volume V=2.4 m³ and rock unit weight γ=26 kN/m³. Weight is W=γV=62.4 kN; this is not an individual bolt demand and does not check a sliding surface. Missing a rear discontinuity understates movable volume even when the visible crown appears intact. Weight estimated only from a frontal image can therefore place support discussions on incorrect geometry and understate the consequences of block release.
units.model: 教學假設，非現場設定或設計允收值。假設塊體體積V=2.4 m³、岩石單位重γ=26 kN/m³，重量W=γV=62.4 kN；這不是單一錨栓的需求，也未檢核滑動面。~Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits. Assume block volume V=2.4 m³ and rock unit weight γ=26 kN/m³. Weight is W=γV=62.4 kN; this is not an individual bolt demand and does not check a sliding surface.
units.verify: 由獲准位置的影像、掃描和地質面誌交叉確認節理方位與塊體輪廓，記錄看不到的背面邊界；比較不同幾何假設對重量及運動可能性的影響，由地質工程師判定需要何種補充證據。~Cross-check images, scans and geological records acquired from approved locations for joint orientation and block outlines. Record hidden rear boundaries. Compare alternative geometries for their effects on weight and possible motion; the engineering geologist determines what additional evidence is needed.
units.failure: 背部節理漏判會低估可移動體積，頂拱外觀完整仍可能有脫離面；若只用正面照片計重，支護討論會建立在錯誤幾何上並低估掉塊後果。~Missing a rear discontinuity understates movable volume even when the visible crown appears intact. Weight estimated only from a frontal image can therefore place support discussions on incorrect geometry and understate the consequences of block release.
units.misconception: 表面沒有明顯裂縫便代表頂拱沒有可移動塊體。~A crown without obvious surface cracks contains no potentially movable rock blocks.
units.practice: 岩塊圖保留方位、比例尺與不可見區，不以課堂重量安排人員進入；支護與進入條件均由現場授權人員依核准風險程序決定。~Retain orientation, scale and hidden regions on the block map. Do not use the classroom weight to authorize access. Authorized site personnel determine support and entry conditions through the approved risk procedure.

units.title: 未支護距離與時間窗~Unsupported distance and exposure time
units.anchor: 未支護距離與時間窗~Unsupported distance and exposure time
units.mechanism: 刀盤到首次形成有效支護的距離會產生暴露時間，隨實際前進速度改變。距離相同不代表風險相同，節理塊體、應力剝落與時間相依變形的機制不同，不能只用設備長度代表穩定性。 假設支護落後距離6 m、平均有效前進0.8 m/h，時間窗6/0.8=7.5 h；速度降為0.4 m/h時為15 h，非允許自立時間。 掘進停頓但支護仍落後時，暴露時間持續增加，設備里程卻沒有變化；若監測只依進尺觸發，時間相依變形的惡化便可能被漏掉。~The distance from the cutterhead to effective support creates an exposure interval that depends on actual advance speed. Equal distance does not mean equal risk: joint blocks, stress spalling and time-dependent deformation behave differently. Machine geometry alone cannot establish stability. Assume support lags 6 m and effective advance averages 0.8 m/h. Exposure time is 6/0.8=7.5 h; at 0.4 m/h it becomes 15 h. These are not allowable stand-up times. When advance stops while support remains behind, exposure time continues to grow although machine chainage is unchanged. Monitoring triggered solely by distance can miss deterioration driven by time-dependent deformation during that stationary interval.
units.model: 教學假設，非現場設定或設計允收值。假設支護落後距離6 m、平均有效前進0.8 m/h，時間窗6/0.8=7.5 h；速度降為0.4 m/h時為15 h，非允許自立時間。~Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits. Assume support lags 6 m and effective advance averages 0.8 m/h. Exposure time is 6/0.8=7.5 h; at 0.4 m/h it becomes 15 h. These are not allowable stand-up times.
units.verify: 用時間標記的掘進里程與支護完成紀錄重建各位置的實際暴露，不以班平均速度代替長停機區間；將地質變化和觀測到的剝落分開標註，與設計假設比較後由支護負責人審查。~Reconstruct actual exposure at each location using time-stamped chainage and support-completion records. Do not substitute shift-average speed for long shutdowns. Annotate geological changes and observed spalling separately, then have the support lead compare the history with design assumptions.
units.failure: 掘進停頓但支護仍落後時，暴露時間持續增加，設備里程卻沒有變化；若監測只依進尺觸發，時間相依變形的惡化便可能被漏掉。~When advance stops while support remains behind, exposure time continues to grow although machine chainage is unchanged. Monitoring triggered solely by distance can miss deterioration driven by time-dependent deformation during that stationary interval.
units.misconception: 機器停止前進就不會增加未支護區的風險。~Stopping machine advance cannot increase risk within the unsupported region behind it.
units.practice: 交接同時列出距離與最長暴露時間，停機期間採核准的觀測與審查安排；不得把計算時間當成可容許等待時間或現場進入許可。~Record both distance and maximum exposure time at handover. Use the approved observation and review arrangements during shutdown. Calculated exposure is neither an allowable waiting period nor permission to enter the unsupported region.

units.title: 錨栓方向與抗力分量~Bolt direction and force component
units.anchor: 錨栓方向與抗力分量~Bolt direction and force component
units.mechanism: 錨栓作用需投影到潛在塊體運動的反方向，幾何偏斜會減少該方向的有效分量。單純加總軸力忽略錨固長度、節理剪動與群體分配，不能取代實際支護系統的驗算。 假設四支錨栓各提供60 kN軸向力，與所需方向夾角30°，合分量4×60×cos30°=207.8 kN；不代表設計容許抗力。 錨栓方向避開預期抗力方向，或錨固終點仍在鬆動塊內，會讓名義軸力無法有效傳回穩定岩體；外觀完好的托板不能排除內部力流中斷。~Bolt action must be projected opposite the potential block movement. Oblique geometry reduces the relevant component. Adding axial forces alone ignores anchorage length, joint displacement and group distribution, so it cannot replace checking the actual support system. Assume four bolts each develop 60 kN axially at 30° to the required direction. Their combined component is 4×60×cos30°=207.8 kN, not a design allowable resistance. A bolt may point away from the required resistance or terminate within the moving block. Nominal axial force then fails to reach stable rock effectively. An intact-looking plate does not rule out an interrupted internal load path.
units.model: 教學假設，非現場設定或設計允收值。假設四支錨栓各提供60 kN軸向力，與所需方向夾角30°，合分量4×60×cos30°=207.8 kN；不代表設計容許抗力。~Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits. Assume four bolts each develop 60 kN axially at 30° to the required direction. Their combined component is 4×60×cos30°=207.8 kN, not a design allowable resistance.
units.verify: 核對竣工鑽向、有效錨固區與試驗紀錄，把力方向畫在同一塊體圖上；拉拔試驗只支援其受測條件，不自動證明所有節理下的剪力和群體行為，差異須送支護設計者評估。~Check as-built orientations, effective anchorage zones and test records, drawing force directions on the same block model. Pull tests support their tested conditions only; they do not establish shear and group behavior across every joint. The support designer assesses those differences.
units.failure: 錨栓方向避開預期抗力方向，或錨固終點仍在鬆動塊內，會讓名義軸力無法有效傳回穩定岩體；外觀完好的托板不能排除內部力流中斷。~A bolt may point away from the required resistance or terminate within the moving block. Nominal axial force then fails to reach stable rock effectively. An intact-looking plate does not rule out an interrupted internal load path.
units.misconception: 把所有錨栓額定軸力相加就是任意方向的抗力。~Summing all nominal bolt axial capacities gives resistance in any required direction.
units.practice: 支護圖應標示目標塊體、錨固終點假設與力方向，保留不符合處置紀錄；任何支數或方向變更需設計者核准，課堂分量不作配置指令。~Support drawings identify the target block, assumed anchorage endpoint and force direction, retaining nonconformity records. The designer approves any change in count or orientation; classroom force components are not installation instructions.

units.title: 噴層厚度與局部彎曲~Sprayed-layer thickness and local bending
units.anchor: 噴層厚度與局部彎曲~Sprayed-layer thickness and local bending
units.mechanism: 噴層跨越小空洞或不平整岩面時可能局部彎曲，純膜力假設會失效。矩形單位寬條帶可展示厚度對截面模數的平方影響，但真實黏結、裂縫與纖維殘餘強度必須另行檢查。 假設寬b=1 m、厚t=0.12 m、彎矩M=2 kN·m，彈性應力6M/(bt²)=833 kPa=0.833 MPa；t降至0.10 m時為1.2 MPa。 背面空洞使噴層成為小跨梁，薄區應力增大且可能出現網狀裂紋；若只檢核平均噴量，局部厚度不足與失去接觸的影響會被掩蓋。~A sprayed layer can bend locally across voids or uneven rock, invalidating a membrane-only assumption. A unit-width rectangular strip demonstrates the squared influence of thickness on section modulus. Actual bond, cracking and residual fiber strength require separate checks. Assume width b=1 m, thickness t=0.12 m and moment M=2 kN·m. Elastic stress 6M/(bt²)=833 kPa=0.833 MPa; reducing t to 0.10 m gives 1.2 MPa. A rear void makes the layer span locally, increasing stress at thin zones and potentially producing a crack network. Checking only average applied quantity can conceal insufficient local thickness and the loss of contact behind the lining.
units.model: 教學假設，非現場設定或設計允收值。假設寬b=1 m、厚t=0.12 m、彎矩M=2 kN·m，彈性應力6M/(bt²)=833 kPa=0.833 MPa；t降至0.10 m時為1.2 MPa。~Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits. Assume width b=1 m, thickness t=0.12 m and moment M=2 kN·m. Elastic stress 6M/(bt²)=833 kPa=0.833 MPa; reducing t to 0.10 m gives 1.2 MPa.
units.verify: 以核准厚度檢測與表面掃描識別薄區，將基面起伏、回彈及黏結觀察一起記錄；用試驗支持材料早齡和殘餘性質，不能從外表平整推論厚度與背面接觸均勻，薄弱區交設計者評估。~Identify thin zones using approved thickness checks and surface scans, recording substrate relief, rebound and bond observations. Tests must support early-age and residual material behavior. A smooth exposed surface cannot establish uniform thickness or rear contact; the designer assesses weak zones.
units.failure: 背面空洞使噴層成為小跨梁，薄區應力增大且可能出現網狀裂紋；若只檢核平均噴量，局部厚度不足與失去接觸的影響會被掩蓋。~A rear void makes the layer span locally, increasing stress at thin zones and potentially producing a crack network. Checking only average applied quantity can conceal insufficient local thickness and the loss of contact behind the lining.
units.misconception: 噴凝土總量充足便保證每一處厚度與接觸良好。~An adequate total sprayed-concrete quantity guarantees sufficient thickness and contact everywhere.
units.practice: 厚度抽驗位置要連結基面異常圖，補強處置保存前後證據；未確認薄區與黏結問題前不得只以追加總噴量完成品質交接。~Tie thickness sampling locations to the substrate anomaly map and retain evidence before and after remediation. Do not close quality handover merely by increasing total sprayed quantity while thin-zone or bond concerns remain unresolved.

units.title: 支護滯後的梁式敏感度~Beam sensitivity to support lag
units.anchor: 支護滯後的梁式敏感度~Beam sensitivity to support lag
units.mechanism: 簡支梁可用來說明暴露跨度增加的非線性效應，但岩體頂拱不是自動成立的均質梁。保持荷載和剛度不變的比較，只能提示幾何敏感度，不能由撓度公式推定現場可自立距離。 假設均布q=20 kN/m、EI=50000 kN·m²，L=3 m時δ=5qL⁴/(384EI)=0.422 mm；L=4 m時為1.333 mm，為原值3.16倍。 裂隙一旦貫通，原有跨越機制可能轉為塊體運動，線彈性撓度不再是可靠預測；硬套梁模式會把突變誤判為平緩且可外推的趨勢。~A simply supported beam illustrates nonlinear sensitivity to exposed span, but a rock crown is not automatically a homogeneous beam. Holding load and stiffness fixed isolates geometry. The resulting deflection comparison cannot establish a permissible unsupported length in the field. Assume uniform q=20 kN/m and EI=50000 kN·m². At L=3 m, δ=5qL⁴/(384EI)=0.422 mm; at L=4 m it is 1.333 mm, a factor of 3.16. Once a discontinuity becomes continuous, the mechanism may change from spanning to block movement. Linear-elastic deflection is then unreliable, and forcing the beam model can misrepresent an abrupt change as a smooth trend suitable for extrapolation.
units.model: 教學假設，非現場設定或設計允收值。假設均布q=20 kN/m、EI=50000 kN·m²，L=3 m時δ=5qL⁴/(384EI)=0.422 mm；L=4 m時為1.333 mm，為原值3.16倍。~Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits. Assume uniform q=20 kN/m and EI=50000 kN·m². At L=3 m, δ=5qL⁴/(384EI)=0.422 mm; at L=4 m it is 1.333 mm, a factor of 3.16.
units.verify: 將量測的暴露長度與頂拱變形時間序列配對，確認支點與連續性假設是否有地質證據；若節理使梁模式不成立，應換用塊體或其他核准模型，不能只調整剛度使曲線貼合。~Pair measured exposure length with crown deformation histories and ask whether support and continuity assumptions have geological evidence. If joints invalidate beam action, use a block-based or other approved model. Altering stiffness merely to fit a curve is not adequate validation.
units.failure: 裂隙一旦貫通，原有跨越機制可能轉為塊體運動，線彈性撓度不再是可靠預測；硬套梁模式會把突變誤判為平緩且可外推的趨勢。~Once a discontinuity becomes continuous, the mechanism may change from spanning to block movement. Linear-elastic deflection is then unreliable, and forcing the beam model can misrepresent an abrupt change as a smooth trend suitable for extrapolation.
units.misconception: 梁模型算出的低撓度便證明岩體暴露跨度安全。~A small calculated beam deflection proves that the exposed rock span is safe.
units.practice: 模型首頁明示梁式僅供敏感度教學，將不連續面與支承假設另表列出；現場支護間距與步距依設計審查，不以四次方算例直接決定。~Label the beam relation as a sensitivity exercise and list discontinuities and support assumptions separately. Field support spacing and excavation increments follow design review, not a direct decision based on the fourth-power classroom example.

units.title: 收斂速率與時間解析~Convergence rate and time resolution
units.anchor: 收斂速率與時間解析~Convergence rate and time resolution
units.mechanism: 相同總收斂若發生於不同時間內，對機制判讀有不同意義；平均速率只描述兩次讀值間的變化，無法揭露中途加速。基準點與量測方向必須穩定，才能把設備附近移動與岩體變形分開。 假設同一測線收斂由8 mm增至11 mm、間隔6 h，平均速率(11-8)/6=0.5 mm/h；若讀值獨立標準差各0.3 mm，差值標準差為0.424 mm。 基準點受到機械震動或自身移動，可能產生假收斂；反覆重設基準又會抹去累積變形，兩者都使趨勢失真並延誤辨識真正的加速。~Equal total convergence over different intervals has different interpretive meaning. An average rate describes change between two readings but cannot reveal acceleration inside the interval. Stable references and measurement directions are needed to separate nearby equipment movement from ground deformation. Assume convergence rises from 8 to 11 mm over 6 h: mean rate is (11-8)/6=0.5 mm/h. With independent reading standard deviations of 0.3 mm, difference uncertainty is 0.424 mm. A reference affected by machine vibration or movement can produce apparent convergence. Repeatedly resetting it can erase cumulative movement. Both distort the trend and may delay recognition of actual acceleration in the surrounding ground.
units.model: 教學假設，非現場設定或設計允收值。假設同一測線收斂由8 mm增至11 mm、間隔6 h，平均速率(11-8)/6=0.5 mm/h；若讀值獨立標準差各0.3 mm，差值標準差為0.424 mm。~Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits. Assume convergence rises from 8 to 11 mm over 6 h: mean rate is (11-8)/6=0.5 mm/h. With independent reading standard deviations of 0.3 mm, difference uncertainty is 0.424 mm.
units.verify: 保留測線方向、基準穩定檢查和讀值時間，使用較短間隔資料檢查平均速率是否掩蓋加速；將儀器誤差與施工事件對齊，不以單一超差值診斷失穩，異常由監測與地工負責人共同審查。~Retain line orientation, reference-stability checks and reading times. Use shorter-interval observations to test whether the mean hides acceleration. Align instrument uncertainty with construction events; a single anomalous value does not diagnose instability and requires monitoring and geotechnical review.
units.failure: 基準點受到機械震動或自身移動，可能產生假收斂；反覆重設基準又會抹去累積變形，兩者都使趨勢失真並延誤辨識真正的加速。~A reference affected by machine vibration or movement can produce apparent convergence. Repeatedly resetting it can erase cumulative movement. Both distort the trend and may delay recognition of actual acceleration in the surrounding ground.
units.misconception: 兩次讀值的平均速率能完整表示區間內變形歷程。~The average between two readings fully describes deformation throughout the entire interval.
units.practice: 保留原始讀值及任何基準修正，修正前後曲線一起交接；監測門檻與升級回報由專案核准，課堂速率不得充作現場警戒值。~Retain raw readings and every reference correction, handing over both original and corrected histories. The project approves monitoring triggers and escalation; classroom rates must not become field warning thresholds.

units.title: 超挖體積與出碴核對~Overbreak volume and muck reconciliation
units.anchor: 超挖體積與出碴核對~Overbreak volume and muck reconciliation
units.mechanism: 開挖輪廓超出名義圓形會增加原位體積，但鬆方出碴還受膨鬆和含水影響。先以相同里程的斷面積差計算原位超挖，再討論重量或鬆方資料，避免把不同體積定義直接相減。 假設名義D=6 m、實測等效D=6.1 m、段長L=2 m，超挖V=π(6.1²-6²)×2/4=1.901 m³；這是原位體積而非鬆方。 以膨鬆後體積和設計原位體積比較會製造大量假超挖，掩蓋真正的局部掉塊；相反若任意調整膨鬆係數配平，實際超挖也可能被隱藏。~Excavation beyond the nominal circle increases in-situ volume, while loose muck also depends on bulking and water. First calculate in-situ overbreak from cross-sectional differences over matching chainage, then compare mass or loose-volume evidence instead of subtracting unlike quantities. Assume nominal D=6 m, equivalent measured D=6.1 m and length L=2 m. Overbreak is V=π(6.1²-6²)×2/4=1.901 m³ of in-situ ground, not loose muck. Comparing loose volume with design in-situ volume creates false overbreak and can conceal localized block release. Conversely, adjusting the bulking factor solely to balance the accounts can hide genuine additional excavation.
units.model: 教學假設，非現場設定或設計允收值。假設名義D=6 m、實測等效D=6.1 m、段長L=2 m，超挖V=π(6.1²-6²)×2/4=1.901 m³；這是原位體積而非鬆方。~Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits. Assume nominal D=6 m, equivalent measured D=6.1 m and length L=2 m. Overbreak is V=π(6.1²-6²)×2/4=1.901 m³ of in-situ ground, not loose muck.
units.verify: 將雷射斷面、實際進尺與出碴稱重對準同一段落，對異形輪廓直接積分而非強迫等效圓；含水與膨鬆係數另列來源及範圍，幾何與質量不一致時保留差額供地質和運輸人員核查。~Align scanned sections, actual advance and weighed muck over the same interval. Integrate irregular profiles rather than forcing an equivalent circle. Record the basis and range of moisture and bulking factors, leaving unresolved geometry-mass differences visible for geological and logistics review.
units.failure: 以膨鬆後體積和設計原位體積比較會製造大量假超挖，掩蓋真正的局部掉塊；相反若任意調整膨鬆係數配平，實際超挖也可能被隱藏。~Comparing loose volume with design in-situ volume creates false overbreak and can conceal localized block release. Conversely, adjusting the bulking factor solely to balance the accounts can hide genuine additional excavation.
units.misconception: 出碴車裝載體積減設計體積就是實際超挖量。~Loaded muck volume minus design excavation volume directly equals actual ground overbreak.
units.practice: 體積報表明列原位、鬆方與含水質量的定義，保存輪廓原始點雲；工程量與地質異常分別審核，不能為了帳面配平消除未解差異。~State in-situ, loose-volume and wet-mass definitions explicitly, retaining original profile point clouds. Quantity measurement and geological anomalies receive separate reviews; unresolved differences must not disappear merely to balance the accounts.

units.title: 運碴能力與積存狀態~Mucking capacity and accumulation
units.anchor: 運碴能力與積存狀態~Mucking capacity and accumulation
units.mechanism: 切削產生率高於搬運能力時，中間積存量必然增加，即使兩台設備各自運轉正常。控制體積的物料平衡需要同一乾濕與鬆方基準，暫存容量只能緩衝短期差額而非消除長期瓶頸。 假設同基準鬆方產生率80 m³/h、移除率65 m³/h，持續2 h增加(80-65)×2=30 m³；若可用暫存20 m³，理想填滿時間20/15=1.33 h。 暫存區逐漸接近容量時，回堵會干擾切削和支護動線；只報告瞬時最大皮帶能力會忽略停機與交接損失，使瓶頸在班平均數中被掩蓋。~When generation exceeds removal, intermediate stock grows even if both machines operate normally. A control-volume balance requires consistent moisture and loose-volume definitions. Buffer capacity absorbs temporary mismatch but cannot eliminate a persistent downstream bottleneck. Assume loose-volume generation 80 m³/h and removal 65 m³/h on the same basis. Two hours add 30 m³; a 20 m³ free buffer fills ideally in 20/15=1.33 h. As a buffer approaches capacity, backup can interfere with cutting and support logistics. Reporting only peak belt capability ignores stoppages and transfer losses, hiding the actual bottleneck within otherwise acceptable shift averages.
units.model: 教學假設，非現場設定或設計允收值。假設同基準鬆方產生率80 m³/h、移除率65 m³/h，持續2 h增加(80-65)×2=30 m³；若可用暫存20 m³，理想填滿時間20/15=1.33 h。~Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits. Assume loose-volume generation 80 m³/h and removal 65 m³/h on the same basis. Two hours add 30 m³; a 20 m³ free buffer fills ideally in 20/15=1.33 h.
units.verify: 對齊皮帶稱重或流量估計、運輸事件與暫存位置觀察，檢查啟停期間的資料缺口；用累計入出量與實際積存變化核對平衡，若長期偏差存在，先查量測基準而不是假定岩體密度突然改變。~Synchronize belt weighing or flow estimates, transport events and buffer observations. Check missing data during starts and stops. Compare cumulative inflow minus outflow with observed storage change; investigate measurement bases before attributing a persistent discrepancy to sudden density changes.
units.failure: 暫存區逐漸接近容量時，回堵會干擾切削和支護動線；只報告瞬時最大皮帶能力會忽略停機與交接損失，使瓶頸在班平均數中被掩蓋。~As a buffer approaches capacity, backup can interfere with cutting and support logistics. Reporting only peak belt capability ignores stoppages and transfer losses, hiding the actual bottleneck within otherwise acceptable shift averages.
units.misconception: 皮帶瞬時額定能力高於切削需求便不可能積碴。~A belt rating above cutting demand makes muck accumulation impossible under all conditions.
units.practice: 班報保存累計曲線及積存估計，運輸與掘進主管共同評估時段差額；任何清理與設備接近均依正式隔離及安全程序，物料平衡不授權作業。~Keep cumulative curves and storage estimates in shift reports so transport and excavation leads can review interval mismatches together. Clearing and equipment access follow formal isolation and safety procedures; a material balance does not authorize the work.

units.title: 環境量測的換氣尺度~Ventilation mixing-time scale
units.anchor: 環境量測的換氣尺度~Ventilation mixing-time scale
units.mechanism: 理想完全混合控制體積的換氣時間可比較風量與空間大小，但隧道實際流場含短路和死角。平均濃度模型不處理局部粉塵峰值、燃燒氣體或緊急情境，因此計算不能取代暴露評估。 假設有效體積V=600 m³、潔淨風量Q=20 m³/s，時間常數τ=V/Q=30 s；無持續污染源時90%衰減需ln(10)τ=69.1 s。 風流短路可能讓出口讀值良好而作業區仍累積污染，平均衰減公式會低估死角清除時間；若據此安排人員接近，模型簡化就被錯當暴露許可。~An ideal well-mixed volume gives a timescale for comparing airflow and space. Real tunnels contain short circuits and stagnant zones. A mean-concentration model excludes local dust peaks, combustion products and emergency conditions, so it cannot replace an exposure assessment. Assume effective volume V=600 m³ and clean airflow Q=20 m³/s. Time constant τ=V/Q=30 s; with no continuing source, 90% decay requires ln(10)τ=69.1 s. Air short-circuiting can produce a good outlet reading while contaminants persist elsewhere. The average decay model understates clearance in stagnant zones; using it to permit access wrongly turns a simplifying assumption into exposure authorization.
units.model: 教學假設，非現場設定或設計允收值。假設有效體積V=600 m³、潔淨風量Q=20 m³/s，時間常數τ=V/Q=30 s；無持續污染源時90%衰減需ln(10)τ=69.1 s。~Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits. Assume effective volume V=600 m³ and clean airflow Q=20 m³/s. Time constant τ=V/Q=30 s; with no continuing source, 90% decay requires ln(10)τ=69.1 s.
units.verify: 以核准儀器在多個位置量測風速與相關環境指標，保留位置、設備活動及採樣時間；比較空間差異以檢查完全混合假設，不能只在風管出口量一次就宣稱工作區達到要求。~Use approved instruments at multiple locations for velocity and relevant environmental indicators, retaining position, machine activity and sampling time. Compare spatial differences to test mixing assumptions. A single reading at a duct outlet cannot demonstrate acceptable conditions across the work area.
units.failure: 風流短路可能讓出口讀值良好而作業區仍累積污染，平均衰減公式會低估死角清除時間；若據此安排人員接近，模型簡化就被錯當暴露許可。~Air short-circuiting can produce a good outlet reading while contaminants persist elsewhere. The average decay model understates clearance in stagnant zones; using it to permit access wrongly turns a simplifying assumption into exposure authorization.
units.misconception: 計算換氣完成時間一到，所有位置便必然安全。~When the calculated exchange time elapses, every location is necessarily safe to enter.
units.practice: 把混合模型與實測暴露記錄分開，測點與允收由職業衛生及通風負責人核准；課堂時間僅用於理解尺度，不作人員進入判準。~Separate the mixing model from measured exposure records. Occupational-hygiene and ventilation leads approve sampling locations and acceptance criteria; the classroom time illustrates scale and is not a criterion for personnel entry.

units.title: 支護交接與抽驗代表性~Support handover and sampling coverage
units.anchor: 支護交接與抽驗代表性~Support handover and sampling coverage
units.mechanism: 支護品質資料須連回位置、批次和施工時段，抽樣比例本身不能保證代表性。異常地層或停機後的材料批次可能集中產生差異，均勻抽樣與風險導向抽查回答的是不同問題。 假設100個支護記錄中抽驗20個，覆蓋率20%；若10個異常區記錄僅抽1個，異常區覆蓋率為10%，不能由總體20%推定同等覆蓋。 抽驗都落在穩定區而異常區缺資料，整體合格率會給出錯誤信心；若交接又遺失批次與位置關係，後續維修將無法有效定位可能的弱點。~Support quality records must link to location, batch and installation interval. Sampling fraction alone does not ensure representativeness. Changed ground or batches used after shutdown can concentrate variation, so uniform sampling and risk-directed inspection answer different questions. Assume 20 of 100 support records are checked: coverage is 20%. If only one of ten anomalous-zone records is checked, that zone has 10% coverage, not the overall 20%. Testing only stable sections while anomalous zones lack records creates misleading confidence in the overall pass rate. Losing batch-location links at handover then prevents maintenance teams from locating the potentially weak areas effectively.
units.model: 教學假設，非現場設定或設計允收值。假設100個支護記錄中抽驗20個，覆蓋率20%；若10個異常區記錄僅抽1個，異常區覆蓋率為10%，不能由總體20%推定同等覆蓋。~Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits. Assume 20 of 100 support records are checked: coverage is 20%. If only one of ten anomalous-zone records is checked, that zone has 10% coverage, not the overall 20%.
units.verify: 把抽驗位置覆在地質與施工事件圖上，確認資料是否集中於容易接近且條件較好的區段；核對未抽驗區的替代證據，將材料批次、修補和未閉合項目逐一列給品質與設計人員審查。~Overlay sampling locations on geological and construction-event maps to detect concentration in accessible, favorable sections. Review alternative evidence for unsampled zones and list material batches, repairs and unresolved items individually for quality and design assessment.
units.failure: 抽驗都落在穩定區而異常區缺資料，整體合格率會給出錯誤信心；若交接又遺失批次與位置關係，後續維修將無法有效定位可能的弱點。~Testing only stable sections while anomalous zones lack records creates misleading confidence in the overall pass rate. Losing batch-location links at handover then prevents maintenance teams from locating the potentially weak areas effectively.
units.misconception: 抽驗比例夠高就無須檢查樣本的位置分布。~A sufficiently high sampling fraction removes the need to examine where samples were taken.
units.practice: 交接表同時列覆蓋率、位置偏差與未閉合項，保留原始試驗及修補版本；品質主管與支護設計者確認限制後簽認，百分比不能自行取代批准。~The handover lists coverage, location bias and unresolved items together, retaining original tests and repair versions. Quality and support-design leads sign after acknowledging limitations; a percentage cannot substitute for their approval.

example: 以下原創算例針對敞開硬岩掘進後方的暴露跨度、岩塊支護與證據閉合，每個輸入都是教學假設而非地標實測資料。教學假設，非現場設定或設計允收值。假設塊體體積V=2.4 m³、岩石單位重γ=26 kN/m³，重量W=γV=62.4 kN；這不是單一錨栓的需求，也未檢核滑動面。教學假設，非現場設定或設計允收值。假設支護落後距離6 m、平均有效前進0.8 m/h，時間窗6/0.8=7.5 h；速度降為0.4 m/h時為15 h，非允許自立時間。兩式只回答各自所列的量與邊界，不應把單一平均結果當成整體穩定證明。請另以最不利的幾何、時間或接觸條件代入，分別標示量測誤差和模型偏差；交接記錄須保留原單位、資料日期以及未能確認的條件。~This original worked example examines exposure, block support and evidence closure behind open hard-rock tbms. Every input is a teaching assumption, not a measured value from a landmark. Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits. Assume block volume V=2.4 m³ and rock unit weight γ=26 kN/m³. Weight is W=γV=62.4 kN; this is not an individual bolt demand and does not check a sliding surface. Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits. Assume support lags 6 m and effective advance averages 0.8 m/h. Exposure time is 6/0.8=7.5 h; at 0.4 m/h it becomes 15 h. These are not allowable stand-up times. Each relation answers only its stated quantity under its stated boundary conditions. A favorable mean value is not proof of overall stability. Recalculate with an adverse geometry, timing or contact condition, distinguishing measurement uncertainty from model error. The handover record must retain original units, observation dates and conditions that remain unverified; the responsible designer decides whether additional evidence is needed.
facts: 教學假設，非現場設定或設計允收值。假設塊體體積V=2.4 m³、岩石單位重γ=26 kN/m³，重量W=γV=62.4 kN；這不是單一錨栓的需求，也未檢核滑動面。~Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits. Assume block volume V=2.4 m³ and rock unit weight γ=26 kN/m³. Weight is W=γV=62.4 kN; this is not an individual bolt demand and does not check a sliding surface.

教學假設，非現場設定或設計允收值。假設支護落後距離6 m、平均有效前進0.8 m/h，時間窗6/0.8=7.5 h；速度降為0.4 m/h時為15 h，非允許自立時間。~Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits. Assume support lags 6 m and effective advance averages 0.8 m/h. Exposure time is 6/0.8=7.5 h; at 0.4 m/h it becomes 15 h. These are not allowable stand-up times.

教學假設，非現場設定或設計允收值。假設四支錨栓各提供60 kN軸向力，與所需方向夾角30°，合分量4×60×cos30°=207.8 kN；不代表設計容許抗力。~Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits. Assume four bolts each develop 60 kN axially at 30° to the required direction. Their combined component is 4×60×cos30°=207.8 kN, not a design allowable resistance.

教學假設，非現場設定或設計允收值。假設寬b=1 m、厚t=0.12 m、彎矩M=2 kN·m，彈性應力6M/(bt²)=833 kPa=0.833 MPa；t降至0.10 m時為1.2 MPa。~Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits. Assume width b=1 m, thickness t=0.12 m and moment M=2 kN·m. Elastic stress 6M/(bt²)=833 kPa=0.833 MPa; reducing t to 0.10 m gives 1.2 MPa.

教學假設，非現場設定或設計允收值。假設均布q=20 kN/m、EI=50000 kN·m²，L=3 m時δ=5qL⁴/(384EI)=0.422 mm；L=4 m時為1.333 mm，為原值3.16倍。~Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits. Assume uniform q=20 kN/m and EI=50000 kN·m². At L=3 m, δ=5qL⁴/(384EI)=0.422 mm; at L=4 m it is 1.333 mm, a factor of 3.16.

教學假設，非現場設定或設計允收值。假設同一測線收斂由8 mm增至11 mm、間隔6 h，平均速率(11-8)/6=0.5 mm/h；若讀值獨立標準差各0.3 mm，差值標準差為0.424 mm。~Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits. Assume convergence rises from 8 to 11 mm over 6 h: mean rate is (11-8)/6=0.5 mm/h. With independent reading standard deviations of 0.3 mm, difference uncertainty is 0.424 mm.
